slides.title: OR ki line vs [[IN]]
slides.note: Same result, **aadhi typing**. Ungliyan bhi khush 🙌

slides.title: Delhi [[ya]] Mumbai
slides.code:
SELECT name, city
FROM employees
WHERE city IN
  ('Delhi', 'Mumbai');

slides.title: Result: [[4]] log
slides.note: List mein jo bhi match ho, row **andar**. Pune wali Riya **bahar**

slides.title: IN = guest [[list]]
points: Shaadi ka bouncer: naam **list** mein hai?

slides.title: List [[query]] se bhi
slides.note: Jinhone **kam se kam ek order** kiya, woh customers. Subquery aage detail mein 😉

slides.right:
WHERE city NOT IN ('Delhi')
-- list se NULL hatao
slides.why: NOT IN mein ek bhi **NULL** = result **khaali**. Kyunki x <> NULL kabhi true nahi 👻
